framing.goal: Prepare a framed working copy without changing the original artwork
framing.audience: Artists using a simple catalogue on Samsung Android

gates.pass_condition: Stored original image SHA-256 matches the pre-framing SHA-256
gates.test_method: Hash original before and after creating framed copy

gates.pass_condition: Mat width equals 17px when an artwork is first added
gates.test_method: Inspect rendered or serialized default mat setting
gates.evidence_required: Measured mat width and test device details

gates.pass_condition: Frame width equals 10px when an artwork is first added
gates.test_method: Inspect rendered or serialized default frame setting
gates.evidence_required: Measured frame width and test device details

gates.requirement: Display the framed copy in My Gallery
gates.pass_condition: Gallery image uses the framed working copy and not the original
gates.test_method: Compare Gallery display with saved framed copy
gates.evidence_required: Gallery observation or screenshot and image identifiers

gates.requirement: Display the framed copy in Promotions
gates.pass_condition: Promotion image uses the framed working copy and not the original
gates.test_method: Compare Promotions display with saved framed copy
gates.evidence_required: Promotions observation or screenshot and image identifiers
